purpose: PR #8 staging file. These expectations were independently reviewed against authoritative Oregon session-law text. They are not part of the gold corpus until source hashes are pinned and the entries are promoted into gold/manifest.json.

documents.reviewBasis: Independently reviewed against Oregon Laws 2026 chapter 11. The title identifies HB 4029 and one ORS amendment, and section 7 expressly amends ORS 646.608. Numerous other ORS citations occur inside the new solar-contract provisions but are not themselves amended. Section 9 and the chapter footer establish the June 5, 2026 effective date.

Independently reviewed against Oregon Laws 2026 chapter 108. The chapter title lists nineteen ORS sections amended by HB 4037 plus a separate amendment to section 22, chapter 476, Oregon Laws 2025. Section 1 also adds a new provision to the ORS 307.213 to 307.237 series; that added-to relationship is evidence but is not labeled as an ORS amendment. Section 31 and the chapter footer establish the June 5, 2026 effective date.

Independently reviewed against Oregon Laws 2025 chapter 371. The title identifies five amended ORS sections and two repealed ORS sections; sections 4 through 8 contain the amendments and section 9 expressly repeals ORS 316.417 and 317.504. Section 10 and the chapter footer establish the September 26, 2025 effective date.

Independently reviewed against Oregon Laws 2025 chapter 590. The title identifies thirteen ORS amendments and seven ORS repeals, while section 1 separately repeals four sections of chapter 592, Oregon Laws 2021; only the seven ORS citations are labeled as ORS repeals. Section 22 declares an emergency and the chapter footer establishes the July 24, 2025 effective date.

Independently reviewed against Oregon Laws 2025 chapter 629. The Act amends three ORS sections and also amends two sections from Oregon Laws 2023. Section 5 expressly repeals ORS 327.496, while section 3a contains a conditional provision tied to HB 2322 that does not change the ORS affected-section label set. The emergency clause makes the Act effective August 7, 2025.

Independently reviewed against Oregon Laws 2023 chapter 519. HB 2931 amends twenty-three ORS sections, all in lettered chapter 475C; the title and section 28 enumerate the same amendment set. Sections 1 through 3 create and stage new provisions that contain many additional ORS citations but do not amend those cited sections. Section 30 and the footer establish the September 24, 2023 effective date.

Independently reviewed against Oregon Laws 2024 chapter 110. SB 1537 is a 26-page housing measure with extensive new uncodified provisions and incidental ORS references, but its title identifies eight ORS sections amended. Section 68 and the chapter footer establish the June 6, 2024 effective date.

Independently reviewed against Enrolled HB 3992 and the official 2025 special-session Oregon Laws foreword. The Act changes appropriations and expenditure limitations by reference to prior Oregon Laws chapters but does not amend or repeal any ORS section. The foreword identifies HB 3992 as chapter 2 and states that its emergency clause made it effective on passage on November 7, 2025.
